chapter: After Basie: Cafe Society to Los Angeles
title: The man who asked if she was colored
summary: A man called her out at Cafe Society to ask if she was colored, saying he had seen her picture and did not know. When she answered, he froze and apologised.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: They really were. Well, I was in my dressing room, you know, and the maitre'd came back, he said, 'Miss Humes there's a gentleman up front that wants to see you'. I said, 'Okay, I'll be right out'. So I went out and I see this fellow standing there and he said, 'Miss Humes, you colored?' I said, 'Well I'm Helen Humes'. He said, 'I saw your picture in the paper and I
